python3 -c "
# Total Liabilities for United Kingdom (in millions USD)
june_2000 = 206014
june_2001 = 172920
june_2002 = 194154

print(f'Total USD: {total_usd} million USD')

# Exchange rate from June 30, 2002 (USD to GBP)
exchange_rate = 0.756939
print(f'Exchange rate: {exchange_rate}')

# Convert to GBP
total_gbp = total_usd * exchange_rate
print(f'Total GBP: {total_gbp} million GBP')

# Rounded to two decimal places
print(f'Rounded: {round(total_gbp, 2)}')
"
